record.body:
## Rationale

Each level gets one children list: the effort lists phases, and the phase lists tasks. The press-to-select, press-again-to-open step goes away, so a click on a phase row has one meaning.

## Counter-argument

The effort page's task table gives a view across all phases and a status filter without a click into a phase. Moving it removes a view that some readers use, and the all-phases scope has no place on the phase page.

payload.alternatives: Keep the task table on the effort page
payload.choice: The task table and status tabs move from the effort page to the phase page; phase rows open the phase page
